scope: Direct TreeVar asin/acos only, using explicit native real-axis branch and JAX complex kernels off the axis.
source_method: For real-axis |x|>1, asin(x)=sign(x)*(pi/2-i*acosh(abs(x))); acos has real0/pi and imaginary copysign(acosh(abs(x)),x). In-domain real-axis input uses direct real kernel. Complex values are assembled from separate real and imaginary components to preserve Inf classification.
dtype_semantics: Eager all-real-axis and outside-domain checks preserve ordinary real outputs and captured native real storage for complex-zero in-domain inputs. This intentionally does not promise JIT on value-dependent dtype paths.
